summary: Iteration 3 testing. Backend: extended pytest suite (test_iteration3.py) covering new `category` field, POST /api/scale-recipe (2->4 numeric doubling + q.b. preserved + empty payload), and POST /api/recipe-image (generation + serving via GET). All 5 new tests PASS. Frontend: verified Home renders dish image at top (data-testid=recipe-image), category badge (Primo Piatto), portion scaler UI + save + share/export/favorites navigation. Portion scaler backend call returned 502 mid-run due to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget being exhausted (RateLimitError in backend log) - not a code defect; scaler already validated via pytest earlier in same session. Timer chip rendering was not manually re-verified in the browser after budget exhaustion; code inspection of StepTimer.extractMinutes + countdown effect is correct.

minor.issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY monthly/budget exhausted mid-run (litellm.RateLimitError: 'Budget has been exceeded! ... Current cost: 0.43, Max budget: 0.4'). Causes /api/scale-recipe, /api/generate-recipe, /api/recipe-image to return 502 until budget refreshed.

action_items: Refresh/top-up EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget - hitting 502 on all LLM endpoints after ~0.43 USD spend.

(Optional) Consider a lightweight local numeric-scaling fallback in /api/scale-recipe (multiply digits by factor) to keep portion recalculation working even without LLM budget - it doesn't need an LLM.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/scale-recipe unnecessarily calls LLM to multiply numbers; a deterministic Python implementation would be faster, cheaper, and immune to LLM budget/quality issues.
Home.jsx fetchImage: image_url is set on recipe state but not persisted to db.recipes for the eventual re-open flow beyond what the backend does (backend already updates Mongo - OK).
RecipeCard.jsx: portion scaler buttons are disabled only during scaling, but there is no visual/aria state when the scale API fails - relies solely on toast; consider revert-highlight.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 new tests + iteration 2 suite still valid)
